notes: Mathlib v4.36 renamed the pinned Submodule.IsLattice (fields fg and span_eq_top) to Submodule.IsFullLattice and reused IsLattice for a different notion (fg plus a linear-independence condition), so the statement of latIn_isLattice, written (latIn L U).IsLattice C, would silently change meaning. The scalars here are a field C with v.Integers O and no IsFractionRing O C hypothesis, so IsFullLattice (which also requires the new linear-independence field) would be strictly stronger than the pinned notion. As PORTING.md prescribes for that case, the conclusion now states the pinned fields explicitly: (latIn L U).FG ∧ Submodule.span C ((latIn L U : Submodule O U) : Set U) = ⊤, which is exactly the pinned Submodule.IsLattice C (latIn L U). The proof, which already built these two components with refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩, is unchanged.
